_comment: #1003 MEASUREMENT-WINDOW per-camera equalization profile -- NOT production. This is applied ONLY during a profile-mode E2E run (MEASUREMENT_EQ=1) via obs_phase2.py apply-measurement-pins, snapshot-set-restore, so production (strih 3/6/20 + stream NDI 2ME PGM 971) is untouched and stays the drift-guard source of truth in scripts/latency-pins-baseline.json. Stores the MEASURED INPUTS (per-camera production pin + measured delivery p50 + measured A/V offset, the production stream hold, and the chosen common delivery target); scripts/e2e_measurement_pins.py DERIVES the equalized-deep pins, the coherent test hold, and --av-expected-ms from these -- the magic outputs (90/160/184/791) are never hand-committed. FRAME-GRID PHASE constraint (2026-08-19 live validation, verdict 1804432786): after delivery-equalizing, each pin is SNAPPED off the FIFO limit-cycle-prone band frac(pin/frame)<0.5 -- cam2's equalized 168 (frac 0.04) reproduced copies-approx-gaps churn live and is snapped to 160 (frac 0.80, 8ms cost); cam1 90 (0.70) and cam3 184 (0.52) are already phase-safe. Phase-safety OVERRIDES exact equality (secondary term) by up to 20ms; the hold then re-zeroes the MEAN snapped delivery so the spread stays ~4ms. To RE-DERIVE after a staleness report: take a recent green profile-mode run's all_cambox_delivery_latency[camN].p50_ms + all_cambox_av_sync[camN].av_offset_ms measured AT THE CURRENT production pins, update the per-camera production_delivery_p50_ms / production_av_offset_ms below, and re-run scripts/e2e_measurement_pins.py resolve to confirm coherence. Seeded 2026-08-19 from the supervisor's Stage-1 delivery measurement (issue 1003 issuecomment-5336139196 / 5336411164): delivery p50 cam1 ~120 / cam2 44.5 / cam3 42.6 and A/V offsets cam1 95.2 / cam2 24.1 / cam3 15.4 at production pins 3/6/20 + hold 971. Caveat (no-overstatement): a STATIC profile is accurate only to ~+/-1 frame per camera per run (#757 per-restart re-phasing) -- fine under the current +/-90ms gate, but it cannot support acceptance item 2's tighten-to-+/-20 (that follow-up must re-derive per run, not blame this lane). SECOND caveat (cam1 bimodality, issue 1033/909): cam1's delivery p50 flips run-to-run between a healthy ~47-64ms and a degraded ~88-144ms grabber mode; cam1's seeded transport (~117) is a HIGH-mode sample, so on a healthy-mode run cam1 can deliver ~62ms below target and show a corresponding A/V residual -- the deferred staleness report (#1124) surfaces this per run; until then, if a profile-mode run shows a large cam1-only residual, re-derive from a run whose cam1 was in the same mode. THIRD caveat (issue 1168 lever 1, 2026-09-01): cam2's PRODUCTION pin moved 6 -> 3 in latency-pins-baseline.json (the projection probe's leftover pin). cam2's production_pin_ms below is STILL 6 because its production_delivery_p50_ms (44.5) was MEASURED at pin 6 -- do NOT naively bump production_pin_ms to 3 (that desyncs transport = p50 - pin by 3 ms). MEQ is superseded + mutually exclusive with the [4i/8align] floor-3 aligner, so it is dormant; when a MEQ-profile run is next needed AND lever 1 is live on the rig, RE-DERIVE cam2's whole entry (p50 + av_offset at pin 3), do not edit production_pin_ms alone.
